mapper.select: SELECT p.*, a.area_name AS area_name, u1.user_name AS manager_name, os.name AS operation_status_name, IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT u2.user_name), '') AS staffs_name_str, IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT gt.green_name), '') AS green_types_name_str, IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT u3.user_name), '') AS green_staffs_name_str, v.license_plate AS vehicle_name, IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT f.name), '') AS facilitys_name_str, u4.user_name AS report_name, ps.name AS plan_status_name, st.name AS task_type_name FROM park p LEFT JOIN sys_area a ON p.area_code = a.area_code AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON p.manager_id = u1.user_id AND u1.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_operation_status os ON p.operation_status_id = os.sys_operation_status_id AND os.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON FIND_IN_SET( u2.user_id, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(p.staff_ids, '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', ''), ' ', '') ) AND u2.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_green_type gt ON FIND_IN_SET( gt.green_type_id, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(p.green_type_ids, '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', ''), ' ', '') ) AND gt.deleted = 0 AND gt.status = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_user u3 ON FIND_IN_SET( u3.user_id, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(p.green_staff_ids, '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', ''), ' ', '') ) AND u3.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_vehicle v ON p.vehicle_id = v.sys_vehicle_id AND v.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_facility f ON FIND_IN_SET( f.sys_facility_id, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(p.facility_ids, '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', ''), ' ', '') ) AND f.deleted = 0 AND f.status = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_user u4 ON p.report_by = u4.user_id AND u4.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_plan_status ps ON p.plan_status_id = ps.sys_plan_status_id AND ps.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_task_type st ON p.task_type_id = st.sys_task_type_id AND st.deleted = 0 WHERE p.deleted = 0 GROUP BY p.id, a.area_name, u1.user_name, os.name, v.license_plate, u4.user_name, ps.name, st.name ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{reqVO.offset}, #{reqVO.pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) FROM park p WHERE p.deleted = 0
